feeds.title: Mom Generations
feeds.description: Mom Generations is a hip online destination for moms, featuring daily fashion news for moms and kids, fabulous giveaways, smart family advice, and the latest celebrity news.

feeds.title: PattyJ.com Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Patty J, founder of PattyJ.com, a RI based lifestyle blog with a funny, smart, fashion-y take on daily life. Be sure to watch for profiles of the coolest people and places in RI and beyond as well as guest blogs from family and friends old and new.

feeds.title: The Mommyhood Chronicles
feeds.description: The Mommyhood Chronicles is a PR friendly blog that informs readers of parenting tips, motherhood, recipes, travel, reviews, and giveaways.

feeds.title: 365 Days of Baking and More
feeds.description: Lynne Feifer shares everyday recipes for life to excite you about food and move you into the kitchen allowing you to spend more quality time with your family!

feeds.title: The Meat & Potatoes of Life Blog
feeds.description: A blog by Lisa Smith Molinari. Lisa is the Humor columnist, Housewife, Military Spouse, Mom, and Author of The Meat and Potatoes of Life.

feeds.title: Mom Foodie
feeds.description: Food, Recipes, Home & Garden, DIY, along with a bit of lifestyle and the occasional oddity. Robin is a Rhode Island food blogger, avid gardener, and single mom to her sweet special needs daughter.

feeds.title: Savor The Thyme
feeds.description: Food, Family, and Lifestyle. Hello, my name is Jennifer Leal and I am a Mom to two teenagers, an Author, Blogger, Defeater of Leukemia, and self-appointed Health Care Advocate.

feeds.title: Grace and Josie
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Melissa! A Rhode Island Blogger and Marketing Manager by day. This blog is all about shopping and scoring deals for the whole family.

feeds.title: Documama
feeds.description: Elizabeth Atalay is a Digital Media Producer and the Managing Editor for World Moms Network. Documama.org was founded as a way to use her documentary background in a new medium.

feeds.title: Small Stories
feeds.description: I'm Kerri Morrone Sparling and I was diagnosed with type 1 diabetes in September of 1986. I started Six Until Me in May of 2005 because I was tired of Googling 'diabetes' and coming up with little more than a list of complications and frightening stories.

feeds.title: Minute With Mary
feeds.description: Mary Larsen discusses motherhood, network marketing, creating your best self, and empowering women as an Independent Younique Presenter.

feeds.title: Sweet lil you
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Sarah and this is my blog. I am a mommy & wife, living in New England. A lover of cupcakes, Boston sports, and Disney. Here at sweet lil you, you'll find posts about crafts & DIY, recipes, reviews, tales of our family adventures, and an honest look at motherhood!
